name: GuardDuty EventBridge Rule Evasion
description: GuardDuty findings are often forwarded to SIEM or SNS via EventBridge rules. An attacker with events:DeleteRule removes the rule that forwards GuardDuty findings, suppressing alerting. Alternatively, events:PutRule and events:PutTargets can modify the rule to point to a dead target or filter out findings. Required permissions are events:DeleteRule to remove the rule, or events:PutRule and events:PutTargets to modify it.
